name: Sabina Kiselyova
source:
"Oh, don't be so uptight! Life without danger is boring, and sometimes you've gotta sacrifice safety to have a good time!"

Loud, brash, and always willing to speak her mind, Sabina makes up for her lack of intelligence with loads of confidence. Her high opinion of herself is clear in her actions and words, and she doesn't take kindly to insults even when she'll gladly give them out to others.

She doesn't mind being excessively assertive if she finds it to be necessary, and no one can get away with criticizing her without facing an expletive-filled retaliation, though her mockery can at times come across as callous and insensitive. However, she does have a softer side, and truly cares for and believes in those around her regardless of how she may act towards them.

All things considered, she's an energetic, fun-loving girl who values simple entertainment even in the face of suffering.
